moments.author: Tom Brady
moments.quote: This guy could throw a marshmallow through a steel door.
moments.why: Brady’s hyperbole after Joe Milton’s arm performance in the Eagles’ historic Thanksgiving comeback is going viral among football fans.

moments.author: Caleb Williams
moments.why: Williams’ five‑word sideline reaction after the game‑winning drive has caught fire, cementing his ‘Iceman’ persona.

moments.author: Kurt Benkert
moments.quote: Caleb Williams is the iceman whether you want to accept it or not
moments.why: Benkert’s praise of Williams after the Bears’ comeback TD amplified the viral ‘Iceman’ hype around him.

moments.author: Joe Milton III
moments.why: Milton’s playful MVP turkey‑leg trophy celebration phrase quickly became a fan‑fav moment online.
